what: FFA pre-drop BEFORE ARM: the pinned sample every anti-passivity change is measured against.
definition: Every completed 'Battle Royale (12)' episode in the league listing as of pinned_at whose public replay re-simulates at GameVersion 45 under tools/extract_events.nim. The episode id list below IS the sample: it is not 'the most recent N rounds', which would name a different sample every day.
metric_of_record: corr(placementScore, killRate) where placementScore = n-1-rank and killRate = 1000*kills/max(1,survivalTicks)

excluded_bucket.why: Episodes recorded under a coworld version whose replays do not re-simulate at GameVersion 45. They are bucketed, never mixed in: extract_events refuses them with 'Replay game version does not match', which is the gate, not a heuristic.
